items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: We had Pokechop. Pokechop and Yeah Man. He was the comedian.

ctx.x: We had Pokechop. Pokechop and Yeah Man. He was the comedian. Yeah, he did. Pokechop and Yeah Man.
That's not the same Pokechop as a dancing today, huh? I don't know if Pokechop and Yeah Man could be.
